reason: Approved within advertisement pricing and offer-presentation scope. The encoded closing frames visibly show the owner-authorized 15.99 SAR with the product, purchase CTA and store address. The offer describes actual 4/5-day programs and 500 app recipes, which I independently checked in local product data. No discount, fabricated reference price, urgency, savings, profitability or sales forecast is required or supported. Production evidence supports delivery completeness; subjective audio quality remains outside my verification capability.

evidence.inspection: Viewed encoded still contact sheet with view_image. At 27.650s and 29.700s, 15.99 ر.س, product cover, CTA and mdaar21.zid.store are clear. At 12.575s the bundle names PDF plus app, 4/5-day programs and 500 app recipes; 18.550s and 22.775s show the calculator/recipe interfaces with estimation/example qualifications.
Viewed with view_image. Sampled handoff frames show product entering around 6.5s and the closing price/CTA settling around 26.08s. These are still samples, not continuous playback.

Both identify 15.99 SAR as the explicit owner instruction dated 28 Oct 2026 Riyadh, scoped to the advertisement. Accepted as task authorization; no claim that the storefront price was changed or independently checked.
Read product JSON directly: 500 recipes and 500 distinct recipe IDs; program keys 4 and 5 have trainingDays 4 and 5. Supports these advertised quantity and program claims.

Inspected existing validation record: 1080x1920, 60/1 fps, 1788 frames, 29.8s, decode exit 0. Independently hashed delivered MP4: 0d741b5bef0424be521ba9938e891d8a4f6163b7e075e4cab592f3f8f8ff3940, matching frozen candidate entry and report.

Read HTML showing 15.99 SAR, MP4 download attribute and product-store link. Existing live report records HTTP 200, local hash matches and HTTP 206 byte range for MP4; I did not perform a new live request.

Read records reporting no pitch change/time stretch/music added, 3.79s audio tail hold, no clipped samples, zero layout/runtime errors and one duplicate-media discovery warning. These records do not establish perceptual audio naturalness or complete music removal.

strengths: Consistent owner price appears in both video closing frames and download player.
Offer quantity and program claims have matching local product data.
Held closing frames pair price, product identity, purchase action and store destination without speculative economics.
limitations: No human listening capability: I cannot certify narration naturalness, intelligibility, absence of separation artifacts or perfect removal of source music. This limits overall perceptual assurance but supplies no evidenced pricing objection.

No continuous video viewing, audience conversion study, checkout, transaction, fulfillment, store-admin inspection or live store-price verification. Approval covers the authorized advertisement, not commercial operations.
The raw owner message is not separately archived in the inspected evidence; owner price authorization is provided by the assigned task packet and claim map.
No cost, tax treatment, platform fees, acquisition cost or demand observations were supplied. None are invented or inferred from 15.99 SAR.
